batting.name: Dhruv Jurel
batting.dismissal: c T Stubbs b AR Patel

batting.name: R Parag
batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b MA Starc

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c Ashutosh Sharma b MA Starc

batting.name: SB Dubey
batting.dismissal: c Ashutosh Sharma b T Natarajan

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c D Ferreira b JC Archer

batting.name: N Rana
batting.dismissal: c Dhruv Jurel b TU Deshpande

balls.text: Axar's let this one burst through his hands... That's one way to end an innings! Natarajan sunk on his haunces. Ferreira ventured down on the front foot to meet this low full toss off the bottom of his bat once more. But his power and timing are such that it almost looks intentional... Ball bursts through Axar's hands, where it was travelling at rocket speed, down at long-off. RR have burgled 225 for 6, with Ferreira 47 off just 14 deliveries!
Banged into the surface, drifting quite wide on the off side. Ferreira thinks it might be past the wide marker but no, the umpires reckon it's a legal delivery. Smart bowling!
Wizardly striking, really. Lowwww full toss outside off, and he somehow gets down on one knee and hammers this over long off. Ball came off the bottom of the bat but the bat speed was superb on this

And he's just got the golden touch right now! Was a slower bouncer, drifting down the off-stump. But Ferreira reaches for this, too early. He checks the angle of his shot across the line at the last moment, and somehow sends it past deep square leg
Another yorker. Flicked off his pads and down to mid-wicket

He does go for a huge lofted shot, but the ball is a low full toss at an angle - on the stumps - where he just can't get under the ball. Flies up in the air and mid-wicket runs in to collect it comfortably
Goes for a wide yorker but lands it on the wrong side of the wide marker

Ferreira had arrived in the IPL in the previous match, and is stamping his authority on this one. He's striking at over three a ball... Mad hitting. Was in the slot, on a fifth-stump line, and Ferreira opens his front leg and swings through the line. Over the extra cover boundary
And now he's put this one away! Going for another wide yorker but was a low full toss. Ferreira gets under the ball and flat-bats this past a diving Kuldeep Yadav at deep point
Another great yorker. On the leg-stump line and he goes for a flick but the bottom-edge runs down to backward point
Right in the blockhole, played down to extra cover now
Slanted way outside off... Ferreira reaches for this but misses the line. Starc really anxious to keep it out of his hitting arc and he's landed it on this occasion
Banged in short but wayyyy too short. Ferreira watches this one sail over him, might as well have been from another planet
Speared in full on the stumps, flicked down to midwicket

Oh lord, this over's been quite the hitting exhibition. He smiles as he walks down to the other end to punch gloves. In the slot once more, right at the stumps. He gets on one knee and swipes this over cow corner. Watched it all the way through in admiration
Back of a length on the stumps. Ferreira goes on the backfoot and tries to launch this one right down the ground. But it stays grounded and Kuldeep fields it
Yeah, the match-up hasn't worked at all here... In the slot once more, lobbed up right on the stumps. Ferreira lofts this one over long-off, clean off the middle of his bat
Ferreira wins round two, and how! The ball was a little too full, outside off. He threads his hands through this and launches this over deep extra cover
Kuldeep does well on the first ball. Was on a length and jumped right at Shubham, who edges this ball off his cut. Down to point
On a length spinning into the batter. He goes on the backfoot and tucks this down to long-on
Crunches this one through deep extra cover! Was in the slot outside off, Dubey bends one knee and sends this shuttling right into the gap
Full but down leg side. Starc will have to bowl another
On a length outside off, Shubham goes for a late glide by opening up the face of his bat. Backward point stationed there to stop it

Parag's been off-strike for a while, and it shows! Parag won't get to a century today, he's shattered as he walks back in. 140.5 clicks, holds a little in the pitch but Parag takes his eyes off the ball right as the ball climbs more than he expected. Cramps him up on the drive, and it is lobbed in the air and right to Axar Patel running in from extra cover
Full and on the stumps, flicked down to long-on

And now Jadeja has to depart. 127.6 clicks - Starc goes for a slower one, short and outside off. Jadeja jumps at this to play it behind him, quite fine, but the lack of pace does his timing in. Straight to Ashutosh Sharma at backward point
Full and speared down leg. 140.3 clicks but speed won't do any good to him on that line

Jamieson has let this one right through him at backward point! The ball was speared in on a length, outside off and moving back in. Jadeja plays a hyper-clever late dab, and the misfield lets this ball run down to deep backward point

Low full toss well outside off, Jadeja goes for a grounded drive. Stubbs puts in a tumbling effort and uses his tall frame to stop this ball from sliding past him, at extra cover. A one-handed stop too
Parag holds the pose on a crisp drive. Full outside off, there to be driven and Parag obliged. But deep cover stationed there for this exact shot
Erring in his line now. Third four in a row: a consequence of another low full toss, down leg and right at Parag's pads. He flicks this down to deep fine leg with a strong whip

Just his second scoring shot behind him! What a great shot too. He thinks of pulling this, then realises the ball is too short and a little slow as the bowler rolls his fingers over this one. He just jumps at this with a ramp shot, and it flies over the keeper's head. Lovely batting
Rifled in full but strays down the pads. Parag places this flick perfectly, down to the empty deep fine leg boundary
Back of a length and sliding past the off side. Cut fine and straight to backward point, where the tall Starc puts in a spirited diving save!
Low full toss againnn, and now Parag has seen enough of these to just thread a silky drive - with a high elbow - down to the vacant long-off boundary
Slow-ish bouncer, Jadeja climbs on top of this and pulls it to square leg

Jadeja reminds us he has these in the bag! Right in the slot on the stumps. Jadeja barely moves beside lofting this drive down the ground - straight as a ruler - and admires his shot in his follow-through
Another low full toss, Parag times this flick really well, but gets it straight to cow corner. Looks a little frustrated as he gets to the other end
short but sailing well over the batter, down the off side. Time to reload
Another great ball, right in the blockhole. Flicked down to cow corner and they get another two

Goes for the yorker, turns into a very low full toss dying on the stumps. Driven down to long-off, where Starc dives in to save this. Might be struggling with cramps in the follow-through, but he's saved the boundary
Speared in even fuller now. He flicks this with a huge backlift, straight to mid-wicket
Parag reminds us there are runs to be had on this pitch! Was floated up on a comfortably full length on the stumps. Parag sets his front foot down leg, and just smashes this one down the ground

And now Ashutosh puts in a great save! Kuldeep span this well outside off, almost near the wide marker. Jadeja flicked this to backward point and set for a run. Parag made it to the crease just in time, by the time KL flicked the bails off
On a length outside off, driven down to extra cover
On a length and significant spin, back into his pads. He almost gets cramped in his stance as he looks to flick this towards square leg
Parag goes for a huge hoick but the ball thuds into his pads, sliding down leg, and runs down to fine leg

He would have been run out by daylight and a half there! Ashutosh misses this completely from backward point. The ball was well outside off, Jadeja dabbed this fine and set off for a run that was never there. he gave up on getting back to his crease but Ashutosh missed the throw by a good margin there
Shorttt ball. Jadeja runs down the track and slaps this from well outside off, flat-batted past a diving cover.  They come back for a smart second
Full-ish outside off. Jaddu drives this one down to covers

Absolutely speared in, Parag inside edges this one into his pads... Or so it seems. Pitching comfortably down leg, and the edge - or not - carries the ball down to backward point. Axar contemplates a review but wisely decides against it. Replays show he might have missed it
Full-ish near the stumps. Jadeja plants a big stride on the front foot and drives this down to long-on
Near the blockhole on the stumps. Helicopters a flick along the ground, down to long-on

Too early on the lofted drive here but he survives... Axar floated this one in the air, on a length. Parag was down the pitch but misread the pace on this ball, checked his shot at the last moment to ensure it falls in front of covers and not in his mitts
On a length and spinning away from the left-hander, flicked down to deep mid-wicket

Oh no... That's a premature end to the party for him, just as he was getting going. Back of a length delivery, spinning into the stumps. There to be hit: he was on the backfoot, but couldn't elevate it over deep midwicket
Jurel gets into the act now! Steps down the pitch to turn this into a full ball, and thumps this over covers
On a length, at the pads. He flicks this towards square leg and takes off
Sliding into the leg stump, he drives this from in front of the stumps and down to deep extra cover

How's he sent that one over the ropes? This is absurd: the ball was back of a length, going down the off stump once more. He jumped on one feet and flat-bats this over covers. The straight-ish trajectory on this shot was straight out of a tennis match
Parag is too set to be missing out on these... Juicy full toss drifting down the off side. He stays deep in his crease and creams this through the covers
Short ball, finishing right at Jurel's shoulder. He swivels on his feet and punches this down to deep mid-wicket

Parag has come storming back into form, and how! Ball was in the slot outside off, driven down to deep extra cover. His first fifty of the tournament, and he looks set for a big 'un on this belter of a pitch
Another thump in the air! Length ball outside off, driven past extra cover, but the fielder is lying in wait near the boundary ropes
Natarajan tries to hide it away but slants it down the wide marker. Time to reload
On a length and moving away from him. Huge thump right down to covers
Pitched up on off, driven to long-off's right along the ground
Drums roll after Parag opens his stance and whips the full ball to long-on
Nearly dragged on, under-edged pull goes to short fine leg's left. Length ball angling towards off, Jurel went for the pull anyway. Crouched a bit but couldn't get low enough
Kuldeep hitting his lengths now. Fuller side of good on off, driven off the back foot to the bowler's right
Length on off, defended towards cover point for a deft single
Full on middle, gets down a step and flicks to deep midwicket
Length on middle and off, punched to cover. Timeout
Fullish just outside off,  bat face opens as he defends towards cover. Hard hands
Length on leg, flicked through midwicket. They look for two but Nissanka swoops in to deny them
Touch back of length on off, punched off the back foot to long-off
High hand speed again. This is pulled against the turn. Bounces just over the front knee-roll but that's enough for Parag to stand beside the ball and swipe it over midwicket
Over DC's dugout beyond long-on. There's room on that 87ks length ball, Parag swipes across, through the hips and middles it
Pitched up on off, defended towards cover point for a quick single
Short on off, not much bounce though, skids through. Jurel comes down and drives to long-on
Back of length on middle, whipped to deep midwicket

Nice slides on the cow-corner boundary. Rizvi went from deep midwicket and stopped the ball in front of Stubbs, who also dove as he was the second line of defence. Was a length ball on off, clipped off the back foot
Pitched up on off, worked to the bowler's right. Kuldeep dives and semi-stops it
Pitched up just outside off, worked to long-on
Axar slings a length ball on leg, flicked to midwicket
Length on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Cut to the off side, stopped with a slide

Short third runs right... and is beaten. Not sure how Jurel managed to scissor that ball after being cramped for room. He danced down, so Axar angled in the length ball towards off. Jurel stopped and then used his wrists to beat the dive
Length on leg, flicked through forward square leg
Length on leg, flicked through to long-on
Pitched up, seemed slow again. Yep, 122ks. Flicked softly towards mid-on for a quick single
Through square leg, ball stops at the edge of the ring. Two taken. Back of length, following the batter as he made room, was flicked along the ground
On the pads, nudged to the leg side for a quick single
Shot of the day, easy! Backs away and walks down at the 136ks length ball on middle and leg, Parag then drives through the line. Holds the pose after sending it over extra cover
Correction in line, Parag marks the answer wrong with a flashy cut over the slips area. Top edge but the shortish ball was pacy enough for it to travel

No-look flick. Parag winding up big, the downswing is gentler and the bat face closes on impact. Bat finishes around head-height, so he didn't follow-through fully. Ball sails over midwicket. Pitched-up ball on middle and leg
Pitched up on off, punched to long-off

Another reverse beaten. DC more interested this time, they take the review. Height and angle could be issues. Shorter side of length, lands on off and beats the bat as Parag got a touch low and looked to swat it behind point. Hawk-Eye says it's going down leg
Beats the reverse. Subdued lbw appeal but impact might've been outside off. Back of length, Parag switched his stance, not grip, and looked to go hard and square
Good bowling. Fullish length ball around off, Jurel looked to drive through mid-off, inside edges to midwicket
Width. Cut. Jurel waits for the 98ks shortish ball to come next to him, gets low and hits it along the ground through point
Back of length just outside off, punched to long-off
Back of length on off, defended towards cover point
Peak Jamieson. Goes on a Test length, pushing full but on a length outside off and getting it to seam away. Parag is beaten on the cover drive
Pitched up, hits the bat hard as Jurel goes for the flowing cover drive. Finds the infielder, who half-stops it
Touch too straight and it's clipped through square leg. Fullish length ball on middle and leg, Jurel gets slightly across and back in the crease to use the pace
Slightly loose but gets it to deep-backward point on the bounce. Parag reaching out with his hands at 140ks for the lofted cover drive
Length on leg, glanced to deep-backward square
Mowed across the line. Around the fuller side of length, Parag stays slightly low and has a swipe across his knees
Inswinging yorker on middlle and leg, Parag does well to clip it to midwicket. Slid leg side to make space and jammed the bat down
Pull beaten this time. Same length, straighter line - around fourth stump. Parag goes for the full-blooded pull and misses
Short and angling away outside off, rises at 140ks and beats the cut
Pitched up outside off, driven to deep third
Pitched up and Jurel creams it square over cover. Not a half-volley but Jurel keeps the elbow high and drives it with a mostly horizontal bat
Length outside off, extra bounce, let go

Whatta yorker! Big swing in at 135ks, hits the crease on the fulll; Sooryavanshi had a slightly open stance, planted feet as he tried to drive the ball through cover. A thin inside edge took it back to the stumps. Jamieson is pumped, he pumps his fists while charging down the pitch and maintaining eye contact with VS. Karun Nair pumps his fists in the dugout
Horror ball for the field. Slow half-volley just outside off, Sooryavanshi takes a small step back, coils upright and munches a drive straight of mid-off. 138s but looked slow
Length around off, defended towards cover point
That nibbled away by a distance! Back of length on off, Jurel dances down and shapes for the cut but winds one leg up and has a late poke. Beaten again
Pitched up just outside off, punched to cover
Takes a step down and punches the fullish ball to mid-off's right for a quick run. 142ks. No Starc vs Sooryavanshi yet
Poke and a miss. 143ks on a hard length lands around off and goes away with the angle. Jurel opens the face to defend but does it tentatively and with a crouch, nearly took the edge
Fullish ball on off, defended to mid-on

That looks out, Jaiswal wants to check the full toss for height but that looked fair. Umps refer it. 143ks around the waist. Jaiswal was on the crease and was taken aback by the pace and trajectory of the ball - it didn't dip at all. He went back in the crease a touch and looked to drive it down the ground. Ball hit high on the sticker and went towards short leg, was in the air for a while, so it was an easy catch for Starc
Length around off, Jaiswal looks to cut and gets it along the ground to slip
Jaiswal needs a sighter, he wants to see the ball 78 metres away. Halfway ball at 142ks at off stump, rose just over waist-height and Jaiswal arches back and swivel-pulls it over backward square leg

Full toss, and it's a no ball! The batters run and the game is all over anyway. Was a waist-high full toss and he mistimes this flick towards fine leg. DC seal a clinical chase of 226. The match might have gone into the final over but DC were dominant in the second half of this innings
And now the match is getting off in a hurry. Well outside off, right in the slot. Ashutosh simply bashes this in the air and down to the deep extra cover boundary

Jofra is furious right now! Bishnoi just wasn't in the right place here, too deep into the field. The ball was on a length and sat up on the stumps for him to flick it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball took one bounce and over the ropes. Bishnoi was running in from cow corner, and might have made it if he wasn't so far away from the ropes
Ashutosh isn't middling these. Maybe he doesn't need to. On a length and he goes for a pull across the line which takes the edge and flies down to long-on instead
Goes for another yorker, mostly nails it. But on leg stump. Bunt down to mid-wicket is good enough for them right now
Perfect yorker. Right on the stumps, more importantly a dot ball. Stubbs does well to not have it rifle into his pads
Full and near the leg-stump line, flicked down to deep mid-wicket
Misses the yorker, but Ashutosh misses the flick too. Was on his pads, but he could only swipe it to in front of long leg
Low full toss, searching for another yorker. Flicked down to cow corner
He's had enough of the wide ones, so this yorker is speared in right at the stumps. Driven down to long-on
He's missing his lines here. It's always an extremely hard line to keep too, but it's wide once more, and the match is slipping from their grasp...
Goes for another yorker on the wide marker, except it travels past the marker...
Stubbs has plugged this full toss right over the long-on boundary! Missed his length completely, Stubbs stays deep in his crease and swings through the line
Wide yorker right on the tramline. This time Ashutosh stays on both feet, but does shuffle into the leg side to open his bat and glide it down to deep backward point now

Now he tries to be too cheeky. The ball was going to be well outside off once more. He gets down on one knee, a tad bit too early, and gets right in the line of the ball. Tries to correct the glide into a scoop but he can't get under the ball. Nasty edge off his bat and into his helmet... We'll get a concussion check.

Whaddashot... There's nothing wrong with that yorker, right inside the wide marker. But he just reaches out with those long levers of his, opens up the face of his bat, and glides this down to the empty deep backward point boundary. All in that timing!
Ashutosh runs down the pitch, but the ball is sprayed well outside the wide crease
Way outside off and past the wide marker. Ashutosh reaches out for this drive, and thumps it down past the covers
Low full toss! On the stumps, Ashutosh reads the line early - it's been predictably blockhole-heavy - and just sweeps this past deep fine leg. Audacious yet smart
On a length attacking the stumps. Ashutosh plays a very late glide as he opens up the face of his bat near his eyeline and plays it past backward point
Yorker but down leg, umpire splays his arms wide
Another yorker-ish delivery on the stumps. Driven down to long-on without much of a hiccup
Sliding down leg side. Was a full toss but Stubbs missed out on that full-blodded flick
Sits deep in the crease once again. Bashes a slower one down to deep extra cover
In the blockhole down the leg stump line, driven down to long-on

Great power on the wrists, even greater placement! Sits up in the slot, drifting into the leg side. Ashutosh hits with a still, powerful base and gets the ball to dissect the gap right between long leg and deep square leg
Full on the stumps, can only drive it right back to Archer
Another full ball outside off. Driven down to deep extra cover for an easy single
Full on the stumps. Ashutosh's flick only takes a huge inside edge, and dribbles over to mid-wicket
Archer spears in a great bouncer. Batter ducks under it. But the ball is too short, the umpire reckons, sailing over and time to reload

And NOW KL is gone! This is the big twist in the tale that they wanted Archer to produce. The ball was there to be hit once more. On a length and he swiped across the line, but he found the fielder right at deep mid-wicket. Just couldn't get the power he needed on the shot to get it over the fielder

KL Rahul's played this with one band off the handle! Lucky to get away not out here. The ball was on a length, on the stumps. He threaded a lofted drive down to long-off, mistimed and almost gobbled up by the two fielders convering. In fact, Shanaka's hand hits the boundary padding and it's four
Great yorker, right outside off. Rahul can only dig a flick out to long-on
Another low full toss, now flicked down to deep mid-wicket
Goes for the yorker, turns into a low full toss on the stumps. Driven right back to the bowler

Jurel goes up in a huge appeal behind the stumps! The ball was right on the wide marker. Rana crouched deeeep in the crease and went for a glide. Edge on this? And Jaiswal's signalled for a review... Big spike on the replay and Rana has to walk back, after an enterprising knock!
Great shot but he'll get only one. In the slot outside off, he drives it down to long-off, but Archer runs in there to save the boundary

It's missed everything and how! The ball was full, outside leg stump. Rahul was even deeper in the crease. He went for a heaving drive and missed completely. Past the keeper's drive and to the ropes it is
Speared in full outside off, and driven down to mid-off oncem ore
Very full outside off. Driven down to covers
Rahul's timed this as sweetly as a rasgulla! The ball was right in the slot, on the stumps, and he played an elegant flick that just heaves this over deep square
Speared into the blockhole, following the batter as he stays outside leg. Driven down to long-on. Not the most aesthetic shot but as long as it gets the job done
Rana's just manipulating the field right now. Short ball, rising right at his chest. But he slides into the off side and gets into the line of the ball. He plays this fine down to deep fine leg
Rana has lofted this with such panache! Well outside off, in the slot. He just threads his hand through the line of the ball, and sails well over the ropes

Another run out was in the offing for a bit... But mid-off misses the throw completely. Another yorker was driven down to the  fielder. And actually, Deshpande couldn't collect this ball at the non-striker's, or we might have had some interest at that end
Another yorker kept outside off. Gets behind the ball and drives it, rather inelegantly, down to long-on
Speared in full just outside off, driven down to mid-off. The fielder runs in and gets a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Jaiswal hit bull's eye here but batter was back in his crease
Big appeal but umpire remains stoic. Great yorker that thuds right into Rana's pads. The ball was pitching outside leg, you think? Interim captain Jurel turns down this chance at a review
Floats in a short ball, off-cutter. Rana reads the pace well ahead of time and just jumps at this ball, travelling over him, down to deep third
Speared right into the blockhole and the stumps, KL Rahul does well to dig this out with a flick towards deep mid-wicket
He's lined this one up real early! Was in the slot well outside off. Rana goes for the inside-out lofted drive over covers
Gets down on his knee for another huge sweep. But the ball is 86.1 clicks, slowwwed down, and beats him with the trajectory
Goes on the backfoot and punches this ball off a good length, outside off, towards covers

He's bashed this over long-on! Sat up from back of a length, there to be hit from wellll outside off. He swings through the line and sends it well over Jofra Archer, who runs in with an optimistic stride near the ropes
On a length and he flicks this, off his hips, into deep square leg
Where's this come out of! The ball is floated up on a slot, near the stumps. He gets down on his knees in a jiffy and sends this wayyy over the ropes over cow corner

Boshes this full delivery down to long-on, and KL Rahul makes his third fifty of the season! To say nothing of that stupendous century. But he knows there's a job to be done here. He raises his bat to the dugout for a couple of seconds, then walks down to his partner
Right in the blockhole, driven down to extra cover
Speared in quite full, on the stumps. Driven down to long-on
Pace off and on a back of a length, he swings at this through the line and towards cow corner
Quite full and on fifth stump. Driven out to deep cover
Around the wicket, back of a length, and right on the wide tramline. There to be hit if he can reach it. He tries, he can't
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Wide on a length, cut to deep point.
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg. 85ks

Nissanka's barbecued himself. He will review but this looks bleak for him. 101ks fullish ball from around the wicket landed on off and went under the bat as Nissanka switched his stance for the reverse sweep. The front leg is in front of off stump and the ball's hit it low on the shin. Impact in line with off and it'd go on to smash off. Jadeja was celebrappealing and that's why
Wide and slightly short, cut to cover, who half-stops it
Wide on a back of length, slapped to long-off
Step-hit into the sight-screen! Just a bit of width, touch too full; Rahul stays leg side and clears his front leg to smoke the googly. Diagonal-bat shot
Wide on a length, cut to deep cover's left. Deshpande saves two

High... and ohmygod it's cleared the lot! That looked like it'll end up in long-on's hands for the most part but it went a couple of rows behind. 86 metres. Was a length ball at the stumps, Rahul swung through the line, looked like he was hurried at first, doesn't matter
Tight second, Throw to the bowler, Nissanka dives, bails whipped off... He's in. Direct hit would've been close. Was a length ball that was flicked to deep square leg
Back of length just outside off, plinks a cut to cover
Floaty from Bishnoi for a change. Wide and full, Rahul gets low and slaps it over extra cover with a horizontal bat
Jadeja slings but goes too short, it's pulled from outside off wide of long-on
Length around off, thick edge takes it to short third. Wanted to hit it to cover, Nissanka
Jaiswal cuts it off at deep midwicket. Good running and fielding from him. Was a touch short and Nissanka pulled that with ease
Back of length outside off, cut to deep point's left. Not perfectly timed but that allows time for two
Wide on a length, slapped to deep cover
Cuts it from outside off to deep point

Rahul manages to cuff it downtown. This looked slower at first but was 107ks. Length ball on middle and off, Rahul made room and slapped it with a mostly flat bat. Bishnoi grimaces as we go into timeout
Jadeja keeps it to one, came in from deep midwicket and picked it cleanly as the batters finished their first. Was a length ball on leg that was flicked
Looks to pull it, but at 106ks it rushes him again. The back of length ball on off goes off the lower-half of the bat to the leg and pops closeby
Back of length skids down leg, flicked through backward square leg again
Length on leg, hurries him a touch as Nissanka goes back and flicks through backward square leg. 106ks
Short on middle, worked to long-on

What a puller Nissanka is! He just swerves the bat like it's an oar, there's no violence in the bat-swing but the ball flies fast nonetheless. Gets it in front of square from in front of the body and brings up a 23-ball fifty
Short at the belly, this looked quicker. Nissanka pulls it just in front of square, Jaiswal runs left and slides to stop it
Rahul dances down and gets cramped by a shortish ball just outside off, cut to the off side of the pitch
Proper half-volley. Inswinger doesn't move in the air and finishes outside off, Rahul imparts pace on it with a flowing drive through cover
Back of length on leg, 121ks, Rahul looked to punch it off the back foot through mid-on. Got it to the bowler's left off the outside half
Pitched right up just outside off, Rahul drive firmly and finds mid-off. He's miffed. 122ks
Back of length just outside off, swat-pulled across to midwicket. 122ks
Full on off, flicked to midwicket
Deshpande aims for the blockhole, overcooks the length and goes too straight. Nissanka whips it late to the left of short fine leg
Length on leg, flicked through square leg. Nissanka placing these shots nicely. 115ks
Low full toss on leg, flicked through squae leg. 145ks
Very low full toss canting just down leg, Nissanka lunges a touch and paddles it without a follow-through. Goes through backward square leg. Couple brings up DC's fifty
Back of length around off, cut into the pitch and it rolls towards point
Nissanka picks the length so very early yet again. 143ks ball is a touch short and is pulled from waist-height well over midwicket. 84 metres
Fullish outside off, 142ks, slaps it hard but finds the infielder at cover point
Pitched up on off, punched to mid-off
Cut to deep backward point's right, Nissanka bustles for two. Just a bit of room and Nissanka uses the angle away
Rifled! Sound off the bat was scary almost. Nissanka pick-up pulled the 146ks back-of-length ball from top-of-leg height
Beaten on the pull this time. Line's slightly outside off this time and Rahul can't drag it across
Short and Rahul pulls it smoothly. Not much bounce, it rises only to waist-height. Rahul lifted the front leg and twirled across while extending his arms and easing it over forward square leg
Back of length on middle, defended to the off side off the pitch
Length on off, defended towards mid-off for a quick single. Direct hit, Nissanka well in
Great shot. Nissanka stays in front of leg stump and moves leg side while late-cutting the back-of-length ball on off stump through third

Concussion test. Hit Nissanka's right temple and rolled through backward point. Ump gives it four and calls for the physio right away. 139ks bouncer around off, Nissanka looked to go aerial and turned his head leg side. Was called leg byes at first but Ultra-Edge shows a spike on the top edge
Burger gives a bit of width and Rahul drives authoritatively over cover. Lifted off a length, was hit from slightly in front of the body too. Bat turned away a touch but ball cleared the infield easy
Pitched up around off, punched to mid-off
Rahul wanted to run it to third but that reared a touch and beat him. Back of a length in the channel, Rahul's hands were high and the bat-face was angled, withdrew his bat late
Under-edge off a flashing cut. Goes into the pitch and then goes to the keeper. Touch back of a length just outside off, Rahul swerved his front leg out the way and went hard
Back of length on top of middle, defended to the bowler
Back of length on leg, Rahul gets slightly inside the line and glances it fine off the back foot
And the bouncer is in. 141ks around head-height just outside off, Nissanka swivelled for the pull but didn't play the shot in the end
Nissanka picks it up behind square. Length ball angling in on the inside-half of the pads, Nissanka doesn't move much and eases an aerial flick
Whacked off a length, Hawk-Eye shows slot but right on the edge, doesn't rise much and comes towards off. Nissanka stands upright and lofts an on-drive over wide mid-on
Archer misses his line looking to follow Nissanka, who made room. The length ball slanted well down leg and went past the attempted heave
Fuller side of length on middle and off, Nissanka has to hop and close the gap between his feet to defend the inswinger in front
Back of length outside off, ball goes off the lower-half as Nissanka cuts towards cover. 140ks
Fuller side of length on off, Nissanka gets square on after standing beside the line. Defends it towards point
